contentEn:
A bathroom renovation in Surrey, BC costs between $28,000 and $55,000 or more in 2026, depending on scope. Reno Stars has completed real bathroom projects in Surrey at these price points, with all costs confirmed from actual contracts.

Surrey Bathroom Renovation Cost by Scope (2026)

Reno Stars priced a complete two-bathroom renovation in Surrey at $28,000–$32,000 for a mid-range modern style project spanning 5–7 weeks. Structural changes, premium tile, or a second floor location push costs toward $45,000–$55,000 or higher.

  • Standard refresh (paint, fixtures, vanity): $8,000–$15,000
  • Full gut renovation (two bathroom, mid-range): $28,000–$32,000
  • Structural change or premium finishes: $45,000–$55,000+

Planning a bathroom renovation in Surrey? Get a free quote from Reno Stars for your specific project scope and layout.

What Drives Your Surrey Bathroom Renovation Cost

Every bathroom project in Surrey has variables that shift the final price. Based on Renovation cost data from real Surrey projects, the primary drivers are:

  • Plumbing relocation — Moving drains or water lines adds $2,000–$8,000 depending on complexity and whether permit involvement is required.
  • Structural changes — Removing a wall or changing the layout requires an engineer and permit, adding $3,000–$12,000 to the project.
  • Floor level — A bathroom on an upper floor costs more to route plumbing and can require additional subfloor work, adding $1,500–$4,000.
  • Finish level — Standard tile and a builder-grade vanity keeps costs at the lower end. Imported marble, heated floors, or custom millwork pushes toward the higher end.

Surrey Bathroom Renovation Timeline (2026)

A mid-range two-bathroom renovation in Surrey typically runs 5–7 weeks from demolition to handover. A full gut renovation with structural changes can extend to 8–12 weeks. All timelines include permit buffer time where applicable.

Surrey Permit Requirements for Bathroom Renovations

In Surrey, a building permit is required when work involves structural changes, plumbing relocation, or electrical modifications. Simple refresh work — painting, replacing a vanity, re-tiling within the existing layout — may not require a permit. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of every project where required, at no additional charge.

BC Building Code 2024 requires all bathroom renovations in Surrey to comply with waterproofing standards for floor areas adjacent to wet zones. Reno Stars uses membrane waterproofing on all shower and wet-area installations.

FAQ — Bathroom Renovation in Surrey, BC

What does a full bathroom renovation cost in Surrey in 2026?

A full bathroom renovation in Surrey typically costs $28,000–$55,000 or more depending on scope. A mid-range two-bathroom project by Reno Stars was priced at $28,000–$32,000 for a modern style finish over 5–7 weeks. Premium finishes or structural changes raise costs toward $45,000–$55,000+.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Surrey?

A standard full bathroom renovation in Surrey takes 5–7 weeks for a mid-range finish. Projects involving structural changes, plumbing relocation, or upper-floor work extend to 8–12 weeks. Permit processing time is included in the project schedule where applicable.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Surrey?

Permits are required when the project involves structural changes, plumbing relocation, or electrical work. Simple cosmetic updates — paint, new fixtures, vanity replacement within the existing layout — do not require a permit. Reno Stars manages the permit process for every project that requires one.

Why choose a Surrey-based contractor for my bathroom renovation?

A Surrey contractor familiar with local permit requirements, supplier networks, and BC Building Code 2024 standards avoids common delays. 影響Surrey浴室翻新成本的主要因素

每個Surrey浴室翻新工程都有影響最終造價的變量。根據Reno Stars在Surrey的真實工程數據，主要影響因素包括：
